During the FY 2025-26, VPLPL was able to maintain its EBITDA at Rs.544 Lakhs (Previous FY 2024-25: Rs.543 Lakhs) by decreasing operating and administrative expenses thereby resulting in decrease of loss from Rs.1671 Lakhs (FY 2024- 25) to Rs.1570 Lakhs (FY 2025-26).

PTBLI has 3 (three) business verticals: • Industrial & Direct B2B • Retail Channel Business • Contract Manufacturing Business The FY 2025-26 witnessed decline in top line by around 14% (57 Billion IDR in FY 2025-26 against 66 Billion IDR in FY 2024-25) resulting in net loss of 15 Billion IDR in FY 2025-26 against a net loss of 18 Billion IDR in last FY 2024-…
Growth & demand: Driven by robust domestic demand, the Indian economy has maintained strong momentum, with First Advance Estimates placing real GDP growth at 7.4% for FY26.

We sustain our formidable market leadership through continuous technological upgradation and a pan-India manufacturing footprint of six plants, achieving growth in both production volume and turnover in FY 2025-26. • Greases & Lubricants (G&L): The domestic finished lubricants market, estimated at around 2.90 billion litres, is expected to reach approximatel…
